user.title: Pair with the main Kiosk server
user.description: Make a pairing code on the main Kiosk server: Settings → Home Assistant Relays → Add relay (or Pairing code). The code works once and for 10 minutes.

data_description.url: Its Tailscale address, e.g. 100.101.102.103 (port 3000 is assumed).
data_description.pairing_code: Ten letters and numbers, e.g. ABCDE-23456. Upper or lower case, with or without the dash.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {relay} again
reauth_confirm.description: The main Kiosk server no longer accepts this relay's credential (it was revoked, or the relay was disabled). Make a new pairing code there (Settings → Home Assistant Relays → New pairing code) and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the main Kiosk server at that address. Check the address and that Tailscale is running at both sites.
error.invalid_code: That pairing code isn't valid: it may be mistyped, already used, or more than 10 minutes old. Make a new one on the main server.
error.relay_disabled: This relay is disabled on the main Kiosk server. Enable it there first.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This relay is already set up.
abort.wrong_relay: That code is for a different relay than this one.

unknown_playlist.message: {player} has no playlist called "{playlist}". Use Automatic or a playlist of its location.

ambiguous_playlist.message: {player} has more than one playlist called "{playlist}". Use its number instead.

not_this_relays.message: {player} isn't one of this relay's screens on the main Kiosk server any more.

command_rejected.message: The main Kiosk server refused that for {player}: {reason}

auth_failed.message: The main Kiosk server no longer accepts this relay's credential. Pair it again (Settings → Devices & services → Kiosk Player).

server_error.message: The main Kiosk server couldn't do that: {reason}

not_a_screen.message: Device {device} isn't a Kiosk screen of a loaded Kiosk Player relay.

play_playlist.name: Play playlist
play_playlist.description: Changes which playlist the screens play. The TVs pick it up within a minute.

device_id.name: Screens
device_id.description: The Kiosk screens (their devices) to change.

playlist.name: Playlist
playlist.description: Automatic (the location's Landscape or Portrait playlist), or the name or number of one of the location's playlists.

refresh_player.name: Refresh screen
refresh_player.description: Makes the screens fetch their playlist again at their next check-in (within a minute).

device_id.name: Screens
device_id.description: The Kiosk screens (their devices) to refresh.
